description: This file defines the EmailAddressRule class, a utility class used in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM for parsing and modifying email address panels in different views. It extends BaseRule and implements logic to identify email fields in detail and edit views, removing or adjusting specific email-related fields.

classes.name: EmailAddressRule
classes.description: A utility class that refines email field display in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM views, specifically handling parsing of email address panels to remove or modify certain email fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for EmailAddressRule; currently empty, inherited from default.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Modifies panels based on view type ('DetailView' or 'EditView') to clean up email address fields, removing or adjusting fields related to email addresses.
